window.title: textgrid-to-Multi-Engine Label Converter
lab.asr.romaji_model.tooltip: Used by Japanese romaji/kana mode; leave empty to auto-detect, falls back to text ASR + G2P when missing
lab.asr.slice.tooltip: Long audio is split at silences before recognition, then all chunk lyrics are merged into one .lab
lab.asr.lyrics.tooltip: Paste the whole lyrics, or load a .txt / .lrc file
lab.asr.use_prompt.tooltip: Send the reference lyrics as a system prompt so the ASR understands what is actually sung
lab.asr.use_match.tooltip: Sequence-align ASR output with the reference lyrics for more accurate lyric/pinyin results
lab.asr.out_hint: The generated .lab keeps the audio name and is written next to the audio by default
log.asr.complete: ASR batch generation finished: {written} succeeded, {failed} failed.

lab.wavname.title: Generate LAB from WAV name
lab.wavname.auto_sp.tooltip: On by default. When on, SP is only added at the head/tail; R in file names is kept as is
detect.title: Phoneme Check (Too Short)
detect.threshold.tooltip: Phonemes shorter than this value (ms) will be listed (regardless of name)
detect.ignore_edge_sp.tooltip: When checked, SP at the start/end of the tier is skipped; SP in the middle is still checked
lab.index.title: Generate LAB from index.csv
textgrid.title: TextGrid Inference (Based on HubertFA)
textgrid.browse_files.tooltip: Multiple selection allowed; selected files take priority over the folder
textgrid.workers.tooltip: Split files across N parallel processes in DML/WebGPU mode (requires enough GPU memory)
textgrid.nonlex.tooltip: Off by default. When enabled, the phoneme sequence gets SP inserted at utterance start/end and between words so alignment can absorb silence; AP/EP come from the model's NLL detector and remaining gaps are filled with SP
json.title: JSON Generate
json.dict.tooltip: Pick a dictionary from the model folder with the dropdown (its full path is filled in here), or type any .txt path / use Browse
mark.oto.title: OTO Generate
mark.oto.cover_tooltip:
Overwrite: write the result into the existing oto.ini
New file: keep the existing oto.ini and write the result to oto_01.ini
Append: add the result to the end of the existing oto.ini
mark.oto.params_tooltip:
5 values
Note: 1/value = percentage:
1. Left ratio
2. Fixed ratio
3. Right ratio
4. Preutterance unchanged
5. Overlap ratio
mark.svdb.title: SVDB Generate
mark.svdb.generate_tg.tooltip: Convert the json data in the voicebank folder (and subfolders) back to TextGrid: word_phone.json -> words tier; when a dictionary is selected, words are split with it (tail ratio) into SV phones for the phones tier, otherwise ds_phone.json phones are used directly
mark.multi_oto.title: Multi-pitch OTO
mark.multi_oto.root_folder.tooltip: Select the root folder containing C4/D4/E4 etc. pitch subfolders
mark.v3db.title: V3DB

tifa.title: TIFA ONNX Forced Alignment
textgrid.batch.tooltip: Audios per model call; larger = higher throughput and more VRAM
textgrid.skip_penalty.tooltip: Cost of skipping a phoneme (zero duration); larger = less skipping
lab.no_r.tooltip: When on, R marks are removed from the generated lab. Off by default (R is kept)
tifa.del_sp.tooltip: Run del_SP after inference to drop redundant or adjacent SP intervals (ignores AP,SP,EP)

mark.volume.out_hint: Leave empty to only detect without moving files; when set, filtered audio is moved into this folder (subfolder structure preserved, duplicate names get a suffix)
mark.volume.threshold.tooltip: RMS is computed in 50 ms frames and then averaged; below this value counts as too quiet. 0 dBFS is full scale (linear 1.0), lower is quieter
mark.volume.peak.tooltip: Maximum amplitude of the whole file. Reaching this value means the audio is not blank and will not be output; only files below BOTH thresholds are listed
mark.volume.hint: Average RMS = mean of 50 ms frame RMS values; peak = maximum amplitude. A file is treated as blank only when both are below their thresholds; when an output folder is set, matching files are moved there.
log.volume.options: Unit: {unit} | Average RMS threshold: {db} | Peak threshold: {peak} | Recursive: {recursive}
log.volume.move_failed: {count} file(s) failed to move (see the log above)
log.volume.complete: Done: checked {count} file(s), {low} below threshold, {skip} skipped because the peak reached its threshold
msg.ok.volume_complete: Detection complete! Checked {count} file(s), {low} below threshold, {skip} skipped due to the peak threshold.
msg.ok.volume_complete_moved:
Detection complete! {low} file(s) matched, {moved} moved to:
{path}
msg.err.volume_threshold: Invalid threshold: dBFS must be below 0; linear amplitude must be within 0-1.
msg.err.volume_out_same: The output folder must be different from the audio folder.
other.lab.section: Build lab from tg words tier
mark.splitlab.lab_ignore_enable.tooltip: Nothing is ignored by default; tick this to skip the marks on the right
mark.splitlab.out_hint: Leave empty to write into <wav folder>/segments
mark.splitlab.silences.tooltip: Comma or space separated (default SP,AP); **empty marks are also treated as split points**. Adjacent split ranges are merged and both neighbouring segments include that range
mark.splitlab.write_tg.tooltip: Write a TextGrid next to each audio segment (tiers are clipped at the split points and shifted to start at 0)
mark.splitlab.lab_out_hint: Leave empty to write next to the TextGrids
mark.splitlab.lab_ignore.tooltip: These marks are skipped in the lab (default AP,SP,EP,R)
mark.words.title: Rebuild words tier from phones
mark.words.out_hint: Leave empty to overwrite the original TextGrid files
mark.csv.title: Generate transcriptions.csv
mark.csv.read_tiers: Read extra TextGrid tiers (words / notes / note_slur)
mark.csv.read_tiers.tooltip: If a words tier exists, generate ph_num/word_seq; a notes tier generates note_seq/note_dur; a note_slur tier generates note_slur
mark.csv.recursive.tooltip: Also scan subfolders (multi-pitch); sample names get a folder prefix (e.g. A4_01) to avoid collisions
mark.csv2tg.title: CSV to TextGrid
mark.csv2tg.out_hint: Leave empty to write next to the CSV
mark.csv2tg.hint: Tiers: words / phones / ph-num / notes / note-slur (no underscores, no spaces); the ph-num tier is always written when ph_num exists (mark = phone count of the group), output <name>.TextGrid. Without a dictionary the words tier is skipped (a dictionary rebuilds it exactly like "Rebuild words from phones")
mark.phnum.title: Add ph_num
mark.phnum.preset.tooltip: Quickly pick a preset C+V set from tg2svdb/cv_dicts; selecting one switches to 'vowels + consonants' and fills both paths
mark.phnum.hint: Grouping: each vowel plus following consonants form one group; fully automatic only for two-part dictionaries.
mark.game.title: GAME MIDI
mark.game.max_chunk.tooltip: Default 30 s; 0 = no chunking. Audio is split at word boundaries (preferring unvoiced phonemes). Lower to 8-16 s if VRAM is insufficient (medium 30 s peaks at ~4.4 GB).
